headline: Executive session on a student's continued enrollment and the superintendent's expulsion recommendation, followed by board action.
summary: The board will look into whether James H. Moran Middle School Student A should continue to enroll and attend school. It will also consider the superintendent's recommendation to expel that student under G.S. 10-233d.
items: Board inquiry into continued enrollment and attendance of James H. Moran Middle School Student A
Board consideration of superintendent's recommendation to expel James H. Moran Middle School Student A under G.S. 10-233d
Board action in response to the superintendent's recommendation or motion on James H. Moran Middle School Student A
item_action_words: Action by the Board in Response to the Superintendent’s Recommendation or Motion
